# Harold Weiss — Anchor LP (State Pension)

- **Relationship:** external; the investment officer representing SCP's **largest Fund III LP**, a
  state pension. Sits on the LP Advisory Committee (LPAC).
- **Cadence:** quarterly LP letter + call; annual meeting; ad-hoc on big deals.
- **Distinguishing fact:** decades in public-pension investing; well-connected among institutional
  LPs and vocal on the LPAC.

## Sensitivities — read before any deal that touches him
- **Hard sector exclusion: the pension's mandate prohibits investing in defense, firearms, or
  weapons-related businesses.** Harold has said he will **redeem / decline to re-up** if the fund
  puts capital into anything defense-adjacent. Screen every new deal against this before briefing
  him, and never route a defense-sector opportunity through his commitment.
- Also cool on tobacco and gambling, but the defense exclusion is the firm one.

## Notes
- Q2 LP letter is owed to him — see [commitments](../commitments.md).
